Package com.cg.training.dao

Interface BookDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
BookDAOImplementation
public interface BookDAO
BookDAO is a Data Access Object interface for managing operations related to Book entities such as adding, removing, retrieving, and saving books.

Implementations of this interface handle the persistence and retrieval logic for Book objects.

Author:
Debangshu Mandal

  • Method Details

    • addBook

      void addBook(Book book)
      Adds a new Book to the data source.
      Parameters:
      book - the Book object to be added; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the book is null or contains invalid data

    • removeBook

      void removeBook(String title)
      Removes a Book from the data source based on its title.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book to be removed; must not be null or empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title is null or empty

    • findBookByTitle

      Optional<Book> findBookByTitle(String title)
      Finds and retrieves a Book from the data source by its title.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book to search for; must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the found Book, or empty if no book with the given title is found
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title is null or empty

    • getAllBooks

      List<Book> getAllBooks()
      Retrieves all Books from the data source.
      Returns:
      a List of all Book objects; may be empty if no books are found

    • saveBooksToFile

      void saveBooksToFile()
      Saves the current list of books to a file.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs while saving the books
